title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Sat 07 Nov
summary: A flat day (forecast moderate). Thermals stayed light all day. The upslope ran from about 09:15 to about 17:00. A low day for November: the base stayed down near 3,900 ft (normal 4,500–5,500 ft). The evening before, the page called it low, about 4,400 ft, a hit. Midday the base averaged about 3,900 ft by the Kekoa camera, 500 ft lower than the evening's number; the morning update said about 5,100 ft, off by 1,200 ft. Most of the day the shear line was crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio; furthest south about 15:53, crossing Kula Highway at the middle Lower Kula Road junction. Data gaps: no readings all day from 1 station (Nakula); the Mesonet could not be reached on 16 of 54 updates.
